t: Refactoring for AI Ergonomics and a Future-Proof CLI Workflow
s: This article details refactoring a codebase to improve 'AI ergonomics' by simplifying workflows, embracing command-line tools like ripgrep and Unix pipes, and avoiding vendor lock-in for AI coding assistants, promoting portability and a future-proof development cycle.
sub: Vendor Lock-in Avoidance with CLI Tools
Unix Pipes and Ripgrep for Workflow Automation
CLI-centric Development vs. IDEs for AI Collaboration
